name: Sheet-Pan Tandoori Chicken and Cauliflower
fit_evidence: 590 cal / 20g carb per serving sits inside the 400-650 cal band and under the 35g carb ceiling; oven sheet-pan dinner (no rice/pasta/potato/bread), scales to 14 with weigh-and-divide across sheet pans, no seafood.
evidence: No catalog or accepted-slugs duplicate. The catalog's Indian/South-Asian chicken dishes are all saucy braised curries (chicken-tikka-masala-burrito, slow-cooker-chicken-tikka-masala-rice-bowls, chicken-madras-curry, cape-malay-chicken-curry). This is a dry-roasted yogurt/coconut-marinated tandoori sheet-pan bake - a different method and plate from a simmered masala curry.
cross_protein_collision_notes: Structurally 'yogurt/coconut tandoori-marinade + cauliflower + onion roasted on a sheet pan' - would collide with any sheet-pan tandoori TURKEY, PORK, or PANEER version in another selector's pool. Decider should watch for a same-dish-different-protein tandoori sheet-pan twin.
Only near-neighbor by spice is a tandoori/tikka chicken curry; distinct here because it is dry-roasted, not sauced - flag only if a second tandoori CHICKEN candidate (curry or sheet-pan) also lands.
